title: heliotropium andrade-limae
intro: Heliotropium andrade-limae, commonly known as 'Chilean heliotrope', is a plant species in the borage family native to Chile. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Heliotropium andrade-limae include its ability to act as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, promoting wound healing and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
